summary: Carlos Sainz won the Australian Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 2.4s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Nico Hulkenberg made the biggest climb, from P16 to P9.
George Russell had a day to forget, dropping from P7 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 2 virtual safety cars.
The stewards penalised GAS (5 second time penalty).
There were 36 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 4 points over Charles Leclerc.
